scope: Actual reading policy and runtime, controlled native callback and real speech-start callbacks. Synthetic timing map checks routing, not real reciter alignment.

Same mapped verse updates clock snapshot without redundant reading broadcasts
Pause and resume preserve native mapped verse without restarting the file or writing recordings
